title: Distinct Values
description: Given an array of N integers, print the number of distinct values in the array.
inputFormat: The first line contains N. The second line contains N integers separated by spaces.
outputFormat: A single integer representing the count of distinct values.

title: Maximum Subarray Sum
description: Given an array of N integers, find the maximum sum of a contiguous subarray (Kadane's algorithm).
inputFormat: The first line contains N. The second line contains N integers separated by spaces.
outputFormat: A single integer with the maximum subarray sum.

title: Prefix Sum Queries
description: Given an array of N integers and Q queries, each query asks for the sum of elements between index L and R (1-indexed, inclusive).
inputFormat: The first line contains N and Q. The second line contains N integers. The next Q lines each contain two integers L and R.
outputFormat: For each query, print the sum on a separate line.

title: Balanced Brackets
description: Given a string containing only the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string is valid. A string is valid if every opening bracket is closed by the same type of bracket and in the correct order.
inputFormat: A single line containing the bracket string.
outputFormat: Print 'YES' if the string is valid, 'NO' otherwise.

title: Palindrome Check
description: Given a string S, determine whether it reads the same forwards and backwards (ignoring case).
inputFormat: A single line containing the string S.
outputFormat: Print 'YES' if S is a palindrome, 'NO' otherwise.

title: Anagram Detection
description: Given two strings A and B of the same length, determine if B is an anagram of A (i.e., B contains the same characters as A in any order).
inputFormat: Two lines, each containing one string.
outputFormat: Print 'YES' if B is an anagram of A, 'NO' otherwise.

title: Connected Components
description: Given an undirected graph with N nodes and M edges, count the number of connected components.
inputFormat: The first line contains N and M. The next M lines each contain two integers U and V representing an undirected edge between U and V.
outputFormat: A single integer: the number of connected components.

title: Odd Cycle Check
description: Given an undirected graph with N nodes and M edges, determine if the graph contains an odd-length cycle (i.e., check if the graph is NOT bipartite).
inputFormat: The first line contains N and M. The next M lines each contain two integers U and V representing an undirected edge.
outputFormat: Print 'YES' if an odd cycle exists, 'NO' otherwise.

title: Shortest Path BFS
description: Given an unweighted undirected graph with N nodes and M edges, find the shortest path (in number of edges) between node 1 and node N. If no path exists, print -1.
inputFormat: The first line contains N and M. The next M lines each contain two integers U and V representing an undirected edge.
outputFormat: A single integer: the shortest path length from node 1 to node N, or -1 if unreachable.

title: Fibonacci Number
description: Given an integer N, compute the N-th Fibonacci number. F(0) = 0, F(1) = 1, F(N) = F(N-1) + F(N-2).
inputFormat: A single integer N (0 ≤ N ≤ 40).
outputFormat: A single integer: the N-th Fibonacci number.

title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
description: Given an array of N integers, find the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.
inputFormat: The first line contains N. The second line contains N integers separated by spaces.
outputFormat: A single integer: the length of the LIS.

title: 0/1 Knapsack
description: Given N items each with a weight W[i] and value V[i], and a knapsack with capacity C, find the maximum total value you can carry without exceeding the capacity. Each item can be used at most once.
inputFormat: The first line contains N and C. The next N lines each contain two integers W[i] and V[i].
outputFormat: A single integer: the maximum achievable value.

title: Coin Change
description: Given a list of coin denominations and a target amount, find the minimum number of coins needed to reach the target. You may use each denomination any number of times. If it is impossible, print -1.
inputFormat: The first line contains N (number of coin types) and T (target). The second line contains N integers representing coin values.
outputFormat: A single integer: the minimum number of coins, or -1 if impossible.

title: Activity Selection
description: Given N activities each with a start time S[i] and finish time F[i], select the maximum number of non-overlapping activities. Two activities overlap if one starts before the other finishes.
inputFormat: The first line contains N. The next N lines each contain two integers S[i] and F[i].
outputFormat: A single integer: the maximum number of non-overlapping activities.

title: Minimum Spanning Cost
description: You have N jobs, each with a deadline D[i] and a profit P[i]. Each job takes 1 unit of time. Maximize total profit by scheduling jobs before or on their deadlines.
inputFormat: The first line contains N. The next N lines each contain D[i] and P[i].
outputFormat: A single integer: the maximum achievable profit.

title: Merge Sort Count
description: Given an array of N integers, count the number of inversions (pairs i < j where A[i] > A[j]) using a merge sort approach.
inputFormat: The first line contains N. The second line contains N integers separated by spaces.
outputFormat: A single integer: the number of inversions.

title: Sort by Frequency
description: Given an array of N integers, sort them in decreasing order of frequency. Elements with equal frequency should be sorted in increasing order of value.
inputFormat: The first line contains N. The second line contains N integers separated by spaces.
outputFormat: N integers on one line separated by spaces in the described order.

title: Greatest Common Divisor
description: Given two positive integers A and B, compute their greatest common divisor using the Euclidean algorithm.
inputFormat: A single line with two integers A and B.
outputFormat: A single integer: gcd(A, B).

title: Prime Sieve
description: Given an integer N, print all prime numbers up to and including N using the Sieve of Eratosthenes.
inputFormat: A single integer N (2 ≤ N ≤ 10^6).
outputFormat: All prime numbers up to N, each on a separate line.

title: Power Modulo
description: Given three integers B, E, and M, compute (B^E) mod M efficiently using fast exponentiation.
inputFormat: A single line with three integers B, E, and M.
outputFormat: A single integer: (B^E) mod M.

title: Find Target
description: Given a sorted array of N distinct integers and a target value T, find the index (1-indexed) of T in the array. If T is not present, print -1.
inputFormat: The first line contains N and T. The second line contains N sorted integers.
outputFormat: A single integer: the 1-indexed position of T, or -1 if not found.

title: Minimum Maximum Value
description: You have N bags and M candies to distribute. Each bag must get at least 1 candy. Find the minimum possible value of the maximum number of candies in any single bag, when distributing exactly M candies across N bags.
inputFormat: A single line with two integers N and M.
outputFormat: A single integer: the minimum possible maximum.

title: Tree Diameter
description: Given a tree with N nodes, find its diameter — the length of the longest path between any two nodes (measured in number of edges).
inputFormat: The first line contains N. The next N-1 lines each contain two integers U and V representing an undirected edge.
outputFormat: A single integer: the diameter of the tree.

title: Subtree Node Count
description: Given a rooted tree with N nodes (root = 1), for each node print the size of its subtree (number of nodes including itself).
inputFormat: The first line contains N. The next N-1 lines each contain two integers U and V representing a parent-child edge (U is the parent).
outputFormat: N integers, one per line: the subtree size of node i for i = 1 to N.

title: Stack Operations
description: Simulate a stack. Given Q operations of two types: '1 X' means push integer X onto the stack, and '2' means pop and print the top element. If the stack is empty during a pop, print -1.
inputFormat: The first line contains Q. The next Q lines contain operations.
outputFormat: For each '2' operation, print the popped value on a new line.

title: Sliding Window Maximum
description: Given an array of N integers and a window of size K, find the maximum value in every contiguous window of size K as it slides from left to right.
inputFormat: The first line contains N and K. The second line contains N integers.
outputFormat: N-K+1 integers separated by spaces: the maximum of each window.

title: Range Minimum Query
description: Given an array of N integers and Q queries, each query asks for the minimum element between index L and R (1-indexed, inclusive). Use a Sparse Table for O(1) per query after O(N log N) preprocessing.
inputFormat: The first line contains N and Q. The second line contains N integers. The next Q lines each contain L and R.
outputFormat: For each query, print the minimum value on a separate line.

title: Two Sum Sorted
description: Given a sorted array of N integers and a target value T, find two distinct indices i and j such that A[i] + A[j] = T. Print the two indices (1-indexed). If no pair exists, print -1.
inputFormat: The first line contains N and T. The second line contains N sorted integers.
outputFormat: Two integers i j (1-indexed), or -1 if no such pair exists.

title: Longest Subarray Without Repeats
description: Given an array of N integers, find the length of the longest contiguous subarray that contains no duplicate values.
inputFormat: The first line contains N. The second line contains N integers.
outputFormat: A single integer: the length of the longest subarray with all distinct values.

title: Rumour Spread
description: N people are numbered 1 to N. Person 1 knows a rumour. Each day, every person who knows the rumour tells all their friends. Find the day on which person N first hears the rumour. If person N never hears it, print -1.
inputFormat: The first line contains N and M. The next M lines each contain two integers U and V representing a friendship.
outputFormat: A single integer: the day person N hears the rumour, or -1.

title: Matrix Rotation
description: Given an N×N integer matrix, rotate it 90 degrees clockwise in-place and print the result.
inputFormat: The first line contains N. The next N lines each contain N integers representing the matrix rows.
outputFormat: N lines each containing N integers: the rotated matrix.

title: Maximum Rectangle in Histogram
description: Given an array of N non-negative integers representing the heights of bars in a histogram (each bar has width 1), find the area of the largest rectangle that can be formed within the histogram.
inputFormat: The first line contains N. The second line contains N non-negative integers representing bar heights.
outputFormat: A single integer: the maximum rectangle area.

title: Suffix Array Construction
description: Given a string S, build its suffix array. Answer Q queries: (L, R, P), count how many suffixes in positions L to R (1-indexed) start with the pattern prefix P.
inputFormat: String S. Q. Next Q lines: L, R, P.
outputFormat: For each query, print the count.

title: Strongly Connected Components
description: Find all SCCs in a directed graph. Print the number of SCCs and nodes in each SCC sorted.
inputFormat: N and M. Next M lines are directed edges.
outputFormat: Number of SCCs. List of nodes for each SCC sorted.

title: Optimal Matrix Chain Multiplication
description: Find the minimum number of scalar multiplications needed to compute the product of N matrices.
inputFormat: N. Next line: N+1 integers representing dimensions.
outputFormat: A single integer.

title: Heavy-Light Decomposition Queries
description: Support node value update and path maximum value query using HLD.
inputFormat: N. N node values. N-1 edges. Q. Operations (1 U X or 2 U W).
outputFormat: Result for each query 2.

title: Chinese Remainder Theorem
description: Find the smallest non-negative integer X satisfying congruences X ≡ R[i] (mod M[i]).
inputFormat: K congruences. R[i] and M[i].
outputFormat: X or -1.

title: Persistent Segment Tree
description: Versioned array updates and range sums.
inputFormat: N, Q. N integers. Operations (1 V X or 2 T L R).
outputFormat: Sum for type 2 queries.

title: Optimal Task Scheduling with Penalties
description: Minimize total weighted tardiness on a single machine.
inputFormat: N tasks. Processing time T[i], deadline D[i], penalty W[i].
outputFormat: Minimum total weighted tardiness.

title: K-th Smallest in Sorted Matrix
description: Find the K-th smallest element in an N×N sorted matrix.
inputFormat: N and K. N matrix rows.
outputFormat: The K-th smallest element.

title: Minimum Window Substring
description: Minimum length contiguous substring of S containing all characters of T.
inputFormat: S and T.
outputFormat: The minimum window substring, or -1.
